metal_framework.geometry_basis: Shared oxygen in CIF bond table (identity symmetry only); M-O vectors use nearest periodic images, M-M separations use the same bridge images, and the metal-site shape uses bridge-connected unwrapped coordinates. M-M values are separations, not metal-metal bonds.

description: XALZIV crystallizes in the monoclinic crystal system with space group C 2/c. Reported CIF formula moiety: C124 H222 Ce22 O88. From the CIF bond table, Ce1 (Ce) has 7 O neighbors; Ce2 (Ce) has 9 O neighbors; Ce3 (Ce) has 8 O neighbors; Ce4 (Ce) has 9 O neighbors; Ce5 (Ce) has 7 O neighbors; Ce6 (Ce) has 8 O neighbors; Ce7 (Ce) has 8 O neighbors; Ce8 (Ce) has 8 O neighbors; Ce9 (Ce) has 9 O neighbors; Ce10 (Ce) has 8 O neighbors; Ce11 (Ce) has 9 O neighbors; Ce1F (Ce) has 7 O neighbors; Ce2F (Ce) has 9 O neighbors; Ce3F (Ce) has 8 O neighbors; Ce4F (Ce) has 9 O neighbors; Ce5F (Ce) has 7 O neighbors; Ce6F (Ce) has 8 O neighbors; Ce7F (Ce) has 8 O neighbors; Ce8F (Ce) has 8 O neighbors; Ce9F (Ce) has 9 O neighbors; Ce10F (Ce) has 8 O neighbors; Ce11F (Ce) has 9 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 71 pairs, 1 components; largest component is a network with cycles with three-dimensional metal-site arrangement. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 3.451-4.171 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 93.79-123.09°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula C124H222Ce22O88. Explicit grouped units in the article formula/name: 4 OH (explicit grouped unit in article compound name (structural notation)).
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.

candidate_structural_motifs.method: agglomerative weighted modularity; edge weight = shared oxygen count
candidate_structural_motifs.interpretation_limit: Algorithmic graph partition, not author-defined units or an assembly pathway. Check symmetry, disorder, bond completeness and article figures before interpreting motifs.

ligand_counts.basis: explicit grouped unit in article compound name (structural notation)
